name: dbpedia_main_aligned_acquired_subgroups_v1
description: Frozen mapping for the existing 33-predicate DBpedia graph. Preserves the current inherited/acquired split and aligns acquired themes with the main Wikidata experiment. Religious authority/recognition is a conceptual counterpart, not an exact equivalent, of religious ordination. Acquired means remaining social relations, not voluntary choice or a demonstrated contemporaneous interaction. All memberships are explicit so new predicates require review.
